FAQ

Good questions.

Are you a clothing designer?

No, but if you need one we are happy to give referrals.

Are you a talent or modeling agency?

No, but if you need one we can refer that too.

Do you produce events nationally?

IAmMoody is headquartered in Minneapolis and serves the Twin Cities metro area, but we can handle your event anywhere in the United States, or globally.

Can you sell my fashion for me?

Sorry, no. We are not a retailer.

Do you only do fashion?

Absolutely not. Fashion is our specialty, but we can handle nearly any event.

Why aren't there prices on the website?

Every event is unique, so pricing is different from event to event. Send us the details and we'll send you a quote.

Where can I learn more about Richard Moody?

Visit richardtmoody.com.

Is IAmMoody hiring?

We are always interested in hearing from people who want to work with us. Email richard@iammoody.com or use the form on this page.
